# Owned skills

<!-- Generated by `bin/skill-map`. Do not edit by hand; run `skill-map`. -->

74 skills, grouped by the kind of work they own. Every runtime
reads this directory through a symlink, so this file is the map of what is
discoverable. **Marks:** `V` vendored from upstream (`.source`), `F` a managed
fork whose local edit must survive refresh (`.local-fork`).
**Routes to** lists sibling skills named in a code span anywhere in the
SKILL.md. That is a superset of the routing-table cells `ai-policy-lint`
resolves, so an entry here is a mention, not a gated reference.

## Skills nothing mentions, and that mention nothing

Reachable only through their own description, so a truncated registry hides
them entirely. Counted by mention, the loose rule above — the stricter set,
skills absent from every routing table `ai-policy-lint` resolves, is larger.
A leaf specialist belongs here; a skill named in prose without a code span
does not.

`gsap-frameworks`, `gsap-plugins`, `gsap-utils`
